items.desc_now: Multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness: turn isolated sessions into a team that assigns work, reviews output, and runs DAG workflows — durable task ledger, real reviewers, crash-safe recovery.
items.desc_prev: Multi-agent orchestration for DeepSeek Harness. Sessions in one workspace assign work, review results, and run DAG workflows — without you as the messenger.
